exposure: Women with a history of cesarean section
cohort: 75,438 women who underwent IVF-ET between January 2013 and December 2018.
finding: First-trimester transvaginal sonography (TVS) has high sensitivity and specificity for diagnosing CSP after IVF-ET, and thinner endometrial thickness on transfer day and multiple embryo transfer are independent risk factors for CSP and HCSP, respectively.
